faq.q: کیا جھیل الدیلفوون مستقل جھیل ہے؟
faq.a: نہیں۔ یہ چھوٹی چھوٹی موسمی جھیلوں کا ایک جھرمٹ ہے، جو بارشوں کے دنوں میں بنتی ہیں، جب پانی نشیبی زمین میں جمع ہو جاتا ہے۔
جھیل الحبیل کے قریب، الاحساء کے شمال میں۔

faq.q: کیا جھیل الدیلفوون کی سیر کی کوئی فیس ہے؟
faq.a: نہیں۔ یہ ایک کھلا عوامی قدرتی مقام ہے جہاں کوئی فیس نہیں۔

blind_reader_rulings.reason: An interface string, not a leaf of this batch: share.btn «اشتراک کریں» is approved text of b0-ui, and the loan he prefers is on the refused list of ruling P16-test by name («شیئر»: the function is «اشتراک کریں» on Android and Chrome; no dictionary entry). He understood it. Recorded for the owner.

Three jobs for «محفوظ», and he paused on asfar. (1) «یہ مقام محفوظ کریں» is approved interface text and is on every page. (2) «محفوظ قدرتی علاقہ» stands once, inside the 2019 announcement, a pending entry with one reference page; no other native wording for a reserve is attested. (3) Booking: «جگہ آن لائن محفوظ کرائی جاتی ہے» was understood at once; ruling P16-test, condition 2, is not met for it (he was not misled), so the loan «بکنگ» does not enter (item N90). Minor by his own grade; the cost is charged under nativeness on asfar.

An interface string, not a leaf of this batch: trails.partOf «ان راستوں میں شامل», approved in b0-ui, where «راستہ» was ruled the word for a trail and the loan refused (P16-test). The heading stands above trail cards that are still English on /ur/ (the reader was shown a gap there), which is why nothing told him what the routes are. Recorded for the interface line and the owner: on a page of lakes and beaches the word is read as "roads".

det.area «علاقہ» is the approved label of every detail page. That the value under it is a direction and not an area is the source's on three of the five lines (asfar, hubail-lake, delfoon-lake give a position only; ruling N30 keeps the source's order). Recorded for the owner with the area lines.

The four labels and four wordings are the sources': "Fees: No fee — open natural site" (asfar), "Hours & entry: Open public site — no entry fee" + "Hours" + "Fees: Free entry" (salwa-beach), "Visiting: Open public natural site — no fee" (the two lakes), and no fee row at all on uqair-beach and the park — in both languages. WHAT MAY NOT BE REWORDED: salwa-beach's three rows (labels and values) and the labels «فیس» and «اوقات» are approved pairs of the translation memory, reused byte for byte. WHAT IS THIS BATCH'S OWN and was checked for alignment: asfar's value and answer, the lakes' label «سیر», their value and their answer. They already say "no fee" in one wording («کوئی فیس نہیں», five times) and "open" with one word («کھلا»); what differs between them is what differs in their English ("natural" / "public natural"), which the Urdu follows word for word and does not even out (no fact is added to a card). The label «سیر» is ruled under N86: it renders "Visiting" and tells of cost no more than the English label does.

«الاحساء» is the city to him on two pages and a region on a third. The sources use the one name for the oasis, the city area and the governorate from page to page ("east of Al-Ahsa" of Al-Uqair, "north of Al-Ahsa" of the lakes, "Al-Ahsa's far south-east" of Salwa, 150 km from Hofuf), and only salwa-beach gives a distance. The Urdu writes the termbase key each time and asserts nothing more (item N88, owner_decision: whether the two lakes lie inside Al-Ahsa). Nothing is supplied.

Applied in both leaves. asfar summary: «آبی اجسام» (change 0), the remedy stage 4 named for this very outcome; the claim of build check C31 keeps its three points. hubail-lake body: «پانی کا ایک پھیلاؤ» (change 19), the Arabic's noun as asfar's body already says it. His own remedy, "simply «جھیلوں میں سے ایک»", is refused on asfar by the owner's guard: bodies of water, not lakes. Item N93.

The line is the template's: the approved interface string det.unesco followed by the component number of the property (1563-012), with no label, on every component page in every language. Not a leaf of the batch. Logged for the owner: the bare number reads as a year range or an extension.

The English yokes the two under one verb ("drawing migratory birds and nature lovers", Arabic «تستقطب»), and the Urdu idiom says "are drawn here" of both. Splitting them would give the birds a verb the source does not have. Minor by his grade; charged under nativeness.

Applied: «اب» is taken out (change 1). He is right that nothing before it sets up a "before"; the habitual present carries "has become a destination" without the question. That the sentence sounds like a brochure is the source's sentence.

Both sources have the two sentences as they stand, and they are the owner's wording (build check C37: a stopover, twice a year): "pass through twice a year" and then "Migratory birds stay here from the onset of winter until May", the noun repeated, with nothing that says whether these are the same birds. Stage 4 took out the demonstrative that had made them the same birds (the fence). The Urdu is as loose as the source and no tighter; when he would see birds, the source does not say.

(a) Applied: the ministry is named with the Urdu possessive, «ماحولیات، پانی اور زراعت کی وزارت» (change 2, item N98); his two remedies are refused by rulings N16 (no marks round a named body) and P8 (no izafat sign). (b) Not applied and not a defect of the Urdu: «بنانے کا اعلان کیا» says an announcement because the source says an announcement — "announced its conversion into a nature reserve" — and the owner guards exactly that (build check C37: the announcement of 2019, not a present status). Whether it was then made a reserve the source does not say; logged.

The chain is the guarded fact in the line's own nouns: north-east of the PALM GROVES of the oasis, never "north-east of the oasis" (build check C37), with «نخلستان» the termbase word for the oasis and «کھجور کے باغات» the ruled rendering of palm groves (N5). That the two say one thing to an Urdu ear is the cost of the oasis word, on record since the calibration; a shorter wording would drop one of the two and break the guard. Charged under nativeness. That it names no town, road or distance is the source's (logged with item 26).

SERIOUS, applied: the cell is «صرف فور وہیل ڈرائیو گاڑی سے» (change 3). He was misled on the one condition a family with an ordinary car must not miss, and the owner guards it. Ruling P16-test is met in all three conditions for this cell (item N90, with the evidence), so the loan enters with a termbase entry that cites P16. His "(4x4)" is not written (a Latin letter, and a figure neither source carries). WHAT IS THE SOURCE'S in the same remark and is logged, not repaired: the condition stands in the card alone — body and questions never mention it — and nothing says why, how far, or what the ground is.

All three points are the source's: "the flocks of birds return" without saying from where; a best time given as an hour of the day with no season, though the body gives winter to May; and sunset recommended on a page whose access needs four-wheel drive, with no word on the way back in the dark. The Urdu says what the field says. Logged; the third point is the one that could harm.
"Open natural site" beside an announced reserve, no hours row, nothing on shade or toilets or how near the water one may go: the source's, in both languages. Nothing is supplied.

Two wordings because the sources have two: "photographers" («المصوّرين») on asfar and "photography enthusiasts" («هواة التصوير») on uqair-beach. The word he would say, «فوٹوگرافی», is refused by the owner's own decision (ruling P16); that earlier readers said it too is on record there.

Both minor and both understood. «… کی سیر کی کوئی فیس ہے؟» is the frame of the approved mosque question with ruling N17's word for visiting; "entry fee" would add "entry" to a question the source asks of a visit, at an open lake. «کو دبائیں»: the verbs he would use («ٹیپ», «کلک») are loans with no entry; ruled under N89, where the link wording «کا لنک کھولیں» stays on record. The marks were clear to him, which is what N89 needed to know.

Applied in summary and body, one string: «گرمیاں گزارنے کے قدیم ترین مقامات» (changes 4 and 5), the Arabic's «الاصطياف», a link shorter. THE SOURCE'S, logged: the body repeats the summary's claim word for word, and "among the oldest summer destinations" sits beside a card that says to keep away from the peak heat.

The circle is the source's sentence: "Along the Arabian Gulf coast stretches the historic Al-Uqair Beach" («على ساحل الخليج العربي يمتدّ شاطئ العقير التاريخي»), a beach along a coast, and "historic" of a beach that only the port beside it explains. The Urdu keeps the two nouns apart as N84 rules («ساحل» the coast, «ساحل سمندر» the beach) and follows the sentence. The repetition of «ساحل» that results is charged under nativeness, not under fit.

His three doubts are the source's three words: "adjoins" («يجاور») — beside it, so on it or not?; "set aside for visitors" («مخصّصة للزوّار») — for them only?; "facilities" — which? The Urdu has «برابر میں», «مخصوص» and «سہولتیں» for them, each the plain equivalent. Nothing is named that the source does not name. Logged.
uqair-beach has no fee row and no hours row in either language; its one card row is the caravan site. No row is written from another page. Logged for the owner.

Applied in all four leaves: «گھر نما گاڑی» (changes 6, 7, 9 and 10). He read the label as "residents' cars": the native description misled. THE LOAN DOES NOT ENTER (item N90): ruling P16-test, condition 1, is not shown — no press page naming the vehicle could be obtained — and condition 3 fails: «کیمپر وین» 0 reference pages, «موٹر ہوم» 1, and the dictionary's «کارواں» is a party of travellers. What he says people say is recorded for the owner. The new description is unread; the next reader is its test.

The wording part applied: «صاف پانی بھرنے اور گندے پانی کی نکاسی کے مقامات» (changes 8 and 11), by the Arabic's two nouns (supply, discharge). THE SOURCE'S, logged: "booked online" with no service, link or name; a long row about caravans on a card that tells a family in an ordinary car nothing about parking.

Minor and understood. «سہ پہر ڈھلنے کے بعد» keeps the source's afternoon ("late afternoon onwards", «العصر وما بعده»); his «دن ڈھلنے کے بعد» moves the hour towards evening and «سہ پہر کے بعد» loses "late". Charged under nativeness. The missing season is the source's.

The circle is in both sources: area "Al-Uqair coast — east of Al-Ahsa", and the answer to "Where is Al-Uqair Beach?" is "On the Al-Uqair coast east of Al-Ahsa, beside the historic Al-Uqair port". No distance or driving time in either language. Nothing is supplied.
Whether one may swim, or usually does, stands in neither language. «کم گہرا» was understood; his «اتھلا» is the exact word and is recorded, not taken on a remark he grades as understood.
Applied: the summary says «سلویٰ قصبے میں» (change 12), as the body and the area line do; both sources say "at" in both fields.

Applied: «سعودی عرب کا دروازہ» (change 13, item N91). His plain version ("where the land border is") is not taken: the gateway is the image of both sources, and "border crossing" is a fact they do not state in those words.

Hofuf is named bare in both sources at its one mention ("about 150 kilometres from Hofuf"). The line does not complete a generic that both sources of a field leave out (the fence of rulings N61, N73 and N77); raised, as that fence asks, and not completed: «ہفوف شہر سے» is on record for the owner as one line.

Applied: the sentence is «انتظامی طور پر سلویٰ الاحساء کے تحت آتا ہے۔» (change 14, item N92). His «ضلعے» is not taken: that a Saudi governorate equals a district is an equivalence neither source states. That the sentence is official in tone and tells a family nothing is the source's sentence.
Applied: «مغربی جانب» (change 16); it cannot be read as the prayer time.
Applied with his own wording: «… ریت میں شمار ہوتی ہے» (change 15).
Applied: «مشہور ہے» (change 17).

The verb applied: «میں ترقیاتی کام کیے ہیں» (change 18); his «سنوارا ہے» is the verb stage 4 withdrew for saying "beautified". THE SOURCE'S, logged: "its park" appears with no earlier mention («حديقته»), "playgrounds" («ملاعب») does not say for whom, and "the municipality" is unnamed on this page though uqair-beach names Al-Ahsa's.

Three rows saying two things in both languages; in the Urdu they are the approved pairs of the translation memory, byte for byte, with the masculine string of ruling N65 (item N87), and may not be reworded. The same card was logged for the owner on the five pages of b5. One row for hours and one for the fee would do.
salwa-beach has no FAQ in either language; swimming and toilets are in neither. Nothing is written.

SERIOUS, and almost wholly the source's. WHAT IS THE SOURCE'S: the page is two English sentences and one Arabic one — how the lake formed, and that it is north of Al-Ahsa; nothing on what one sees or does, on the water (a lake of farm drainage), on the road or the vehicle; and the English itself ends by saying that extent and facilities are unconfirmed (the Arabic lacks even that). A translation cannot fill it and does not (invent nothing). WHAT WAS WORDING, and is ruled under his item 40: the reservation sentence lost him and sounded official; it is reworded (change 20, item P4). Nothing else on the page is the Urdu's. No point is taken from fit for the source's share. FIRST among the batch's defects for the owner: a page that tells a family nothing they can plan on, and says so.

Both languages call a lake formed by drainage water an "open public natural site" («موقع طبيعي عام مفتوح»), and state "open, public, no fee" flatly on a page whose own text says the facilities are unconfirmed. The row is marked verified in the source. The Urdu follows the row. Logged.

Applied on both pages (changes 20 and 22): item P4, ruled at its first bite. The sentence is «مزید تفصیلات کی معتبر ذرائع سے تصدیق ابھی باقی ہے», the plainer predicate stage 4 kept as its fallback for this outcome; on hubail-lake the main clause now closes before the two things it names. His own wording ("ابھی ہمیں مصدقہ طور پر معلوم نہیں") is not taken: it says the site does not know, where the source says confirmation from reliable sources is pending — how the site states a reservation of its own is the owner's (ruling P25); recorded as his option. On delfoon-lake "details of what?" is the source's sentence, which names nothing.

Minor. «زرعی نکاسی کا پانی» is the source's term, "agricultural drainage water" («مياه الصرف الزراعي»), and he worked it out; his paraphrase adds "surplus". The two names for the land are two source nouns: "farms" («مزارع», «کھیت») here, "palm groves" («نخيل», «کھجور کے باغات») on asfar — ruling N5 keeps them apart.

SERIOUS, and wholly the source's and the template's; nothing in it is wording. (1) Summary and body are one sentence in both languages (the source has no other text): the Urdu has it twice because the page has it twice. (2) The source has no area field, so no location row is rendered: the only page of the six without one. (3) The card has one row, Hours; no fee row in either language. (4) The notice under the card is the approved interface string det.hoursNotice, printed on every page that shows hours, and it speaks of fees whether or not the card has a fee row. The Urdu sentence itself he read without a remark. No point is taken from fit. For the owner: a body text, an area line and a fee row.

Not applied; ruled under N94, and charged. «مظاہرہ» read as a protest on first pass and then as a show. His remedies are the loan «شو», which ruling P16-test does not admit here: condition 1 is not shown — the one press page found for the thing says it in native words, «فواروں کا رقص» (dailypakistan.com.pk, 10 January 2017, HTTP 200) — and nothing was obtained that writes the loan of a fountain. Of the native nouns, «مظاہرہ» is the one the reference site has for a staged display («آتش بازی کا مظاہرہ» 10 pages; «آتش بازی کا تماشا» 0), and the press's "dance of the fountains" says a dance and several fountains where the Arabic has shows of one. The second reader is the test (N94). THE SOURCE'S, logged: the fountain stands only in this bracket, and "after sunset" is no hour.
What makes the park "environmental" is said in neither language; the adjective is in its name and in its one sentence. Nothing is supplied.

The sentence is the approved interface string det.hoursNotice with det.hoursNotice.op; he found it clear. That no phone, site or other way to reach the management is given is the page's data in every language; that salwa-beach states hours and carries no notice is the template's rule (the notice is not printed on a page flagged as an open site). Logged.

Minor; neither stopped him. «عبد اللہ» in two words is ruling N27 (the joined form is recorded for search in the entry). The section name is the breadcrumb crumb.leisure, ruled under N96: it is the two nouns of the approved menu label; that the site puts markets and parks in one section is the site's.

The name is built letter for letter from the Arabic «الديلفوون», which has the two waws (transliteration follows the Arabic spelling, never the English; no vowel sign is added: ruling P17). A doubled «وو» that looks like a slip is the look of the Arabic name itself; "Delfoon" in the English is no better guide. Bare at the head of the paragraph and with «جھیل» in the title, as both sources have it (N95). Recorded for the owner: an Urdu reader cannot tell how it is said.

One lake in the title and the three questions, several in the summary, the body and the first answer — in both languages (item N95). He says the first question clears it up, and well: each field follows its own source.

The wording part applied: one word on the page, «پسندیدہ», as the Arabic has one (change 21). THE SOURCE'S, logged: a "favourite spot" of which the same page says that further details are unconfirmed, and whose favourite is not said.

No months for the rainy spells, no road, no vehicle, in either language. Nothing is supplied. For the owner, with asfar's access row in mind: low desert ground after rain is where an ordinary car gets stuck.

Minor: "unusual though pretty". «جھرمٹ» is the English's "cluster", and its singular carries the seam between the one lake of the question and the several of the answer (N95). Kept; charged lightly under nativeness.

source_defects.where: hubail-lake: the whole page (reader item 38, serious; 39)
source_defects.defect: Two English sentences and one Arabic one: how the lake formed, and "north of Al-Ahsa". Nothing on what a visitor sees or does, on the water of a lake formed by farm drainage, on the road or the vehicle. The English ends by saying that the lake's extent and any visitor facilities are "pending confirmation from reliable sources"; the Arabic has no such sentence. The card calls the drainage lake an "open public natural site — no fee", marked verified, on a page whose own text says the facilities are unconfirmed.
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: Carried as it is; nothing supplied. The reservation is worded as ruled under P4. HARM, the greatest in the batch: the reader would not go, and the page made him "wonder how much the site knows about the other places". FOR THE OWNER: either a paragraph a family can plan on (what is there, how one gets there, in what car) or no page yet; and the reservation in the Arabic too if it stays.

source_defects.where: king-abdullah-park: the whole page (reader items 42 serious, 43, 44, 45)
source_defects.defect: Summary and body are the same single sentence in both languages. No area field (the only page of the six with no location row). One card row, Hours; no fee row, under a notice that says hours and fees may change. "Fountain shows after sunset": plural, no hour, and the fountain is mentioned nowhere else. "Environmental" is not explained. The notice sends the reader to the management and the page gives no phone or site.
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: The one sentence stands twice; no row is written; the bracket follows its source (the plural said as a singular: item N94). HARM: "the one place that sounds made for a family evening, and I cannot tell where it is, what is in it, or what it costs". FOR THE OWNER: a body text, an area line, a fee row, an hour for the fountain.

source_defects.where: asfar: access, best time and birds (reader items 14, 15, 11, 16, 8)
source_defects.defect: The condition "four-wheel-drive vehicles only" stands in one card row; the body and the four questions never mention it, and nothing says why or how far off the road. Best time is "at sunset" on that same page, with no season (the body gives winter to May) and no word on driving back in the dark. The birds "pass through twice a year" and then "stay here from the onset of winter until May", with nothing to say whether they are the same birds. "Open natural site" beside an announced reserve; no hours, no facilities. The header prints the component number 1563-012 with no label.
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: Each statement carried at its own strength; the access cell made unmistakable (change 3); nothing moved from the card into the body. HARM possible: a family at sunset on ground that needs four-wheel drive. FOR THE OWNER: the access condition in the body and in a question, with its reason; a season beside the hour.

source_defects.where: hubail-lake and delfoon-lake: "north of Al-Ahsa", seven leaves (reader item 6; item N88)
source_defects.defect: English "north of Al-Ahsa", Arabic «شمال الأحساء», which reads "north of" or "the north of". Neither page says whether the lakes lie inside Al-Ahsa, and the site uses "Al-Ahsa" for the oasis, the city area and the governorate from page to page ("east of Al-Ahsa" of Al-Uqair; "Al-Ahsa's far south-east" of Salwa, 150 km from Hofuf).
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: «الاحساء کے شمال میں» in the seven leaves: the wording that asserts least (it is said in Urdu, as in the Arabic, of a place beyond a region and of a place in its north). OWNER'S DECISION (N88): where the lakes lie. If inside Al-Ahsa, «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» returns in all seven by one replacement.

source_defects.where: the cards of the six pages: fee and access rows (reader items 5, 22, 36)
source_defects.defect: The same fact — free, open — is laid out four ways: asfar "Fees: No fee — open natural site"; salwa-beach "Hours & entry: Open public site — no entry fee" + "Hours: Open 24 hours" + "Fees: Free entry" (three rows saying two things); the two lakes "Visiting: Open public natural site — no fee"; uqair-beach and the park no fee row at all. "Natural", "public" and "open" come and go between the rows (and the Arabic of asfar says "public" where its English says "open").
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: Each row follows its own English word for word; salwa-beach's three rows are approved pairs of the translation memory and are not reworded. The batch's own rows already share one wording for "no fee" and one word for "open". FOR THE OWNER: one label and one wording for a free open site, and one row for it.

source_defects.where: uqair-beach: body, card and answers (reader items 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27)
source_defects.defect: The body repeats the summary's claim word for word. "Along the Gulf coast stretches the beach": a beach along a coast; "historic" of a beach. "Adjoins shades and facilities set aside for visitors": on the beach or beside it, for visitors only or not, which facilities. The caravan site is "booked online" with no service named (and the row's internal source names another body as announcer than the value names as builder: not rendered). No fee row, no hours row, no word on swimming at a beach said to suit families. "Where is Al-Uqair Beach? On the Al-Uqair coast": circular; no distance.
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: Followed sentence for sentence; nothing named that the source does not name. The claim's chain and the water points were reworded for form only (changes 4, 5, 8, 11).

source_defects.defect: Hofuf is named bare at its only mention. "Its park" has no earlier mention; "playgrounds" does not say for whom; "the municipality" is unnamed. "The Kingdom" is never named as a country on the page. "Falls administratively under Al-Ahsa governorate" tells a visitor nothing. Three card rows say two things. No FAQ; nothing on swimming or toilets.
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: Bare where both sources are bare (no generic for Hofuf, no name for the municipality). Two repairs of form, both logged: the country is said by its name (N91) and the generic "governorate" is left out (N92). OPTIONS FOR THE OWNER, one line each: «ہفوف شہر سے»; «مملکت» restored; «محافظہ الاحساء» restored.

source_defects.where: delfoon-lake: title against text; the reservation; the name (reader items 47, 48, 49, 50; item N95)
source_defects.defect: One lake in the title and the three questions, several in summary, body and first answer, in both languages. The English summary says "favourite spot" and the body "lovely destination" where the Arabic has one word; the English body then says further details are unconfirmed (no Arabic). No months for the rains, no road, no vehicle. The Arabic name «الديلفوون» is spelled with two waws and its English is "Delfoon".
source_defects.effect_on_urdu: Each field keeps its source's number; one word for the Arabic's one (change 21); the name letter for letter from the Arabic, unvocalised. The reader could not say it aloud. FOR THE OWNER: how the name is pronounced, and whether the title should be plural.

source_defects.where: asfar faq[2].q; asfar body (stage 4's list, kept)
source_defects.defect: The question asks "part of the UNESCO site" without "World Heritage"; the body gives the inscription no year (sahood and khuzam give 2018). "Announced its conversion into a nature reserve": whether it became one is not said.

calibration.evidence: STAGE 4: FIRST BITE of the item: the last English body sentence of hubail-lake ('Further details about the lake — its extent and any visitor facilities — are pending confirmation from reliable sources.') and of delfoon-lake ('Further details are pending confirmation from reliable sources.'). Neither has any Arabic (the Arabic bodies end before it); the German and Russian lines translated it, the Chinese line dropped it. It is rendered text and the English is the translation source, so it is translated. The item's provisional field says it is not to be worded before it is ruled, and the style rule pending_phrase repeats that: the wording in the text is therefore stage 1's PROVISIONAL one, kept untouched through stages 2 to 4, and its shared part is byte-identical on the two pages (compared by script: «مزید تفصیلات» … «ابھی معتبر ذرائع سے تصدیق کی منتظر ہیں۔»). A says what the English says and no more: 'still awaiting' («ابھی … منتظر»), 'reliable sources' («معتبر ذرائع»), no promise, no date. «منتظر» with an inanimate subject is written Urdu, a little formal (stage 3's reading from the localizer's seat); B is plainer and moves 'details' into a possessive. Whatever the judge rules for the sentence, the short form (D) stays to be ruled at its own first bite (the events pages), and should be built on the same noun, «تصدیق». ‖ STAGE 7, ROUND 1: THE READER read A on both pages (his item 40, moderate): on hubail-lake "I lost the thread between «تفصیلات» and «منتظر ہیں»", and «معتبر ذرائع سے تصدیق کی منتظر ہیں» "is newsroom / official Urdu"; on delfoon-lake "shorter but vaguer — «مزید تفصیلات» of what?". E changes what the site says of itself (that it does not know) and drops the source's "reliable sources": the kind of repair rulings P24 and P25 send to the owner.

calibration.ruling_or_recommendation: B, in two points. (1) THE SENTENCE, for running text: «مزید تفصیلات کی معتبر ذرائع سے تصدیق ابھی باقی ہے۔» — the confirmation is the subject, the predicate is the plain «ابھی باقی ہے», "reliable sources" stays, and nothing is promised: no date, no "will be added".
